gr_list.description: Shared DTOs + error codes: ListRecordDto += id (long, JsonPropertyName 'id'); new AddListRecordRequest {phone, name?, surname?, email?}, AddListRecordResponse {record, total_records, sendable_count}, DeleteListRecordResponse {deleted, total_records, sendable_count} in DataListDtos.cs. ErrorCodes.cs += ContactListRecordDuplicate=INV-OB-088 (409), ContactListRecordNotFound=INV-OB-089 (404).

DataListRepository: records-page SELECT += id column (and the shared MapRecord — if preview-sample shares the mapper, its SELECT gets id too, ordinal-consistent). New InsertRecordAsync + DeleteRecordAsync, HER IKISI tek tx ve LOCK-FIRST sirayla (Codex PR-001/PR-002 fix): (1) SELECT status, total_records FROM data_lists WHERE tenant_id=@tid AND id=@lid FOR UPDATE -> satir yoksa ListNotFound, status!='ready' NotReady, (insert'te) total_records+1>cap CapExceeded — hepsi KILIT ALTINDA karar verilir (parent-lock mutasyon+recompute'u serialize eder, READ COMMITTED recompute anomalisi kapanir); (2) INSERT (NULLIF empties, sendable=TRUE, custom_fields NULL, status'a dokunulmaz) veya DELETE WHERE tenant_id AND list_id AND id (0 rows -> RecordNotFound); (3) ayni tx'te COUNT(*) tabanli sayac recompute UPDATE RETURNING total_records/sendable_count. INSERT'te PostgresException 23505 SADECE ConstraintName=='uq_list_record_list_phone' ise Duplicate outcome (Codex PR-003 fix), diger unique ihlalleri rethrow. Repo typed outcome enum + counters doner; SELECT pre-check YOK.

ContactListImportService: AddRecordAsync (gate Allowed->046; payload null / phone-normalize fail via PhoneNormalizer.Normalize -> 047; trim+length-cap name/surname 255, email 320; sonra repo cagrisi) ve DeleteRecordAsync (gate->046; repo cagrisi). Varlik/status/cap kararlari ARTIK REPO TX'INDE (FOR UPDATE altinda) — servis repo outcome'unu INV koduna map eder: ListNotFound->049, NotReady->051, CapExceeded->048, Duplicate->088, RecordNotFound->089, NpgsqlException->053. Same (response, errorCode, message) tuple pattern as RecordsPageAsync; ayri GetAsync on-sorgusu YOK (tek otorite = kilitli tx).

Outbound Program.cs: POST /api/v1/data-lists/{id:long}/records (201) + DELETE /api/v1/data-lists/{id:long}/records/{recordId:long} (200), TenantContext + X-Request-Id pattern identical to siblings; ContactListStatus switch += 088->409, 089->404.

Backend Program.cs: two proxies — MapPost /api/v1/outbound/data-lists/{id:long}/records -> OutboundProxyPost, MapDelete /api/v1/outbound/data-lists/{id:long}/records/{recordId:long} -> OutboundProxyDelete (existing helpers, verbatim path forward).

verification_questions.question: Are both new endpoints tenant-scoped end-to-end — list ownership enforced via tenant_id in every SQL WHERE (insert, delete, recompute) — so a foreign tenant's listId/recordId yields 404 without leaking existence?

Are single-record INSERT/DELETE and the data_lists counter recompute executed in ONE transaction with full COUNT(*)-based recompute, so total_records/sendable_count can never drift from actual rows even under concurrent mutations?
Is duplicate-phone detection race-safe — relying on the uq_list_record_list_phone unique constraint (PostgresException 23505 typed catch) rather than a non-locking SELECT pre-check?

Are status/cap/existence decisions taken INSIDE the mutation transaction under a data_lists FOR UPDATE row lock (no check-then-write TOCTOU window at all), so a concurrent import flipping status to 'importing' can never interleave with a single-record mutation or its counter recompute?

Do all failure paths return typed INV-OB codes via the existing tuple pattern (no broad catch(Exception), NpgsqlException base caught -> INV-OB-053), and does the UI map 088/047/048/051 to specific Turkish messages instead of a generic error?

forbidden_areas: Bulk import pipeline (ImportAsync/ImportRecordsAsync scenarios) — davranisi degismez
Broadcast/run/send yollari (outbound_messages, bulk_send_jobs) — kayit silme calisan run snapshot'larini etkilemez, dokunulmaz
DB schema/migration — mevcut 052 semasi yeterli, yeni migration YOK

first_contact_at set edilmez (import INSERT'i de set etmiyor — parite)

Recompute UPDATE'i status kolonuna dokunmaz (import'taki recompute status='ready' yazar; tekil mutasyon icin gereksiz ve 'failed' listeyi diriltme riski tasirdi — non-ready zaten tx icinde FOR UPDATE altinda reddedilir)
